title: GIG-3371: Install Worktree Dependencies From The Lockfile
description: Stops copying vendor and node_modules into a new worktree so the project's startup install builds them from the lockfile.

test_plan.description: A new worktree does not receive a copied vendor or node_modules
steps: Confirm vendor and node_modules stay absent in the worktree after start and await
Run vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Unit/Command/ReviewCommandTest.php and confirm priming is still awaited before the reset step
